facts.text: The user asked for help summarizing a relational data model.
The domain is farmer-suppliers booking kills at meatwork plants.
A company is the top level unit of organisation.
A season has a start and end and is the broadest unit of time organisation.
A season belongs to a company.
A programme is a smaller subset of time.
A programme has a species, such as a lamb.
A programme is a smaller subset of time within a season.
A week is a subset of time within a programme.
A booking is on a week.
A booking has a specific programme.
